usage: The word 風褸 (fung1 leoi6) is a noun that refers to a light jacket.
You can use 風褸 to talk about outerwear that is not too heavy but protects against wind or slight chill.
In sentences, 風褸 usually follows a verb related to wearing or buying, such as '攞' (to take/wear) or '買' (to buy).
When describing colors or styles of the jacket, adjectives usually come before 風褸, e.g., '紅色風褸' (red light jacket).
You can also use 風褸 in questions like '你有冇帶風褸？' (Did you bring a light jacket?).
